SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Futures Pare Losses, Dow Drops After Scaling Record Highs— CoreWeave, Vistra, Microchip Technology In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Tuesday following Monday's rally that saw the Dow Jones jump nearly 600 points to an all-time high, driven by geopolitical developments in Venezuela. Key movers include CoreWeave rising on Nvidia partnership plans, Vistra gaining on a $4.7 billion acquisition, and Microchip Technology advancing on better-than-expected guidance. Treasury yields held steady at 4.17% for the 10-year bond, with markets pricing in an 83.9% probability of unchanged Fed rates in January.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
